name: Pokémon Plasma
summary:
Welcome to Luminaria, a radiant island where the laws of nature are enforced by the powerful Plasma Police. As a newly graduated Pokémon Trainer, you set out to challenge the region's Gyms while meeting allies, rivals and many other characters along the way.
Pokémon Plasma expands on the classic Pokémon formula with criminal captures, raids, crafting, side quests, mini-games, an enhanced Shiny system and a more developed Trainer career path. Players can explore the region, train Pokémon from multiple generations and continue into a challenging post-game.
Pokémon Plasma is a free, unofficial and non-commercial Pokémon fan game.
